config.grain_rationale: Each record is one QBCC licence held by a licensee (individual or company). Business attributes of the licence holder (name, ABN, ACN, business address) are mapped onto the entity; licence-specific attributes (number, grade, class, financial category) are not entity fields and are left unmapped.

record_id.rationale: '_id' is the CKAN datastore row id and is 508/508 distinct in the discovery sample; 'Licence Number' had only 506 distinct out of 508 rows (duplicate licence numbers), so it is not unique per record.

fields.rationale: Column is the licensee name; publisher evidence states a licence is issued to an individual or company (legal persons) and the name is the entity as named on the licence. Values are personal/company registered names (e.g. 'JUSTIN WILLIAM PAGE', 'FLASH AIR CONDITIONING AND ELECTRICAL PTY LTD'), so legal_name rather than trading_name.
ABN column of shape '99 999 999 999' with 99.6% checksum validity in profiling; the abn transform strips spaces and validates checksum.
ACN column of shape '999 999 999' with 100% checksum validity in profiling; acn transform strips spaces and validates checksum.

Publisher evidence: the company application collects the licensee's business address and it is published in the register. Values are a combined street/locality/'QLD'/postcode string; no reliable separate locality/postcode columns, so only the full address is mapped.
State abbreviation (e.g. 'QLD') is embedded in the address string; extracted by regex then normalised via the state transform. Sample is a QLD register so nearly all will be QLD.

constants.rationale: Queensland Building and Construction Commission register; all addresses in profiling carry an Australian state (QLD).

unmapped.reason: CKAN internal datastore row id; used only for record_id, not a business identifier.
Identifies the licence, not the business; also not unique per record (506 distinct / 508 rows). Mapping a licence ID as a business identifier would be wrong.

Describes whether the licence is held by an individual or company. Publisher evidence states a licence category does not by itself establish the holder's legal form, so this is ambiguous for entity_type; left unmapped to avoid a wrong enum.
Coded form (I/C) of Licence Type DESC; same ambiguity for entity_type.
Financial category of the licence (e.g. 'Self Certification - Trade'); a licence attribute, not an entity field.
Coded form of the licence financial category; not an entity field.
Grade of the licence (Trade Contractor, Site Supervisor, etc.); a licence attribute, not an entity field.
Class/occupational category of the licence (Carpentry, Plumbing, etc.); a licence attribute, not an entity field.

config.notes: Advertised as CSV but the resource is a CKAN datastore_search JSON response: records live under result.records (record_path), with an outer help/success envelope. Individual licence holders appear as personal names in Licensee Name (legal_name for natural persons is acceptable here since the licensee is the legal person holding the licence; entity_type intentionally left unknown because Licence Type individual/company is a licence category, per publisher evidence). Business addresses are single combined strings with an embedded state; only address.full and address.state mapped, locality/postcode not reliably separable. No date columns present, so no entity.date_registered or observation.valid_* set. One ABN in the sample fails checksum and is correctly rejected by the abn transform.
